findings.title: Generator input states three actual augmentation keys but catalog has exactly two

findings.risk: A fabricated deletion denominator would make source closure and receipt narration false.
findings.disposition: Correct exact denominator to five operations plus create/cancel augmentation keys.

findings.title: Historical U03 receipt-chain and affected-L2 failures remain disclosed

findings.risk: Static outcomes could be misrepresented as L2, business or cleanup closure.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: Correctly removes an unapproved duplicate platform invite path while retaining approved operations and public journeys.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Hiding the tab while retaining HTTP or fixture compatibility leaves the prohibited face and is rejected.

solutionReasonableness.verdict: NO_GO until M1 and M2 are repaired.
